summary: Wrote test spec tests/specs/API-02.md with 35 test cases covering all 7 API-02 routes (POST /definitions, GET /definitions, GET /definitions/:id, PUT /definitions/:id, PATCH /definitions/:id, DELETE /definitions/:id, POST /definitions/:id/activate) and all HTTP status codes from the acceptance criteria. Created tests/unit/api02_handler_test.zig with 10 pure input-validation unit tests (no DB required) covering malformed UUID and invalid parameter early-exit paths. Created tests/integration/api02_crud_test.zig with 22 integration test cases covering happy paths and all documented error cases for Store methods (create, list, getById, update, hardDelete, activate, deprecate, archive). Registered the integration test in tests/integration/main_test.zig and the unit test in build.zig. Fixed a pre-existing blocker: clearLastViolations() in src/definition/store.zig was not marked pub but was called from src/api/routes/definitions.zig::handleActivate — this caused a compile error blocking the entire test suite. Made the method pub to unblock compilation. zig build test exits 0.
